text.p: Here are highlights from Polish newspapers this morning.
- Poland's deputy finance minister Krzysztof Kalicki will become the first deputy president of the Pekao SA bank and will remain the advisor to the finance minister Grzegorz Kolodko.
- The Krakow-based Huta Sedzimira steel mill invested 480 million zlotys in plant development this year, the company said.

- Poland's national power grid PSE has contracted electricity supplies for the next 20 years from the Patnow-Adamow-Konin electric power plants' complex. Though the value of the contract was not announced it will allow the power complex to invest $300 million in plant development in the next three years.
- The cities of Kalisz, Torun, Legnica and Polkowice have recently been covered by the Era GSM digital mobile phone network, Era's representative Robert Niczewski said.

- The listed Universal capital group has proposed the treasury ministry several changes in the privatisation programme of the Ruch news-stand chain. Accordingly, France's Hachette concern would acquire a 40 percent stake in the chain, a 20 percent stake would go to Universal, another 20 percent would be sold in a public offer, while 15 percent would be distributed among the employees and the state treasury would keep the remaining five percent, Universal said.
- Foreign investments in Poland this year amounted to $4 billion, the Polish Foreign Investments Agency (PAIZ) president Waldemar Dabrowski said.
-Polish and German icebreakers on the Odra river waterway are ready to come into operation any time the need arises, the Szczecin-based Water Economy Management director Andrzej Kwapiszewski said.
- Investing in stock on the Warsaw bourse brought greatest profits this year compared with other form of investment.

- Impexmetal foreign trade company plans to become the strategic investor in the Krasnik-based FLT ball bearings' maker and is ready to invest 77 million zlotys in development in the next two years, Impexmetal said.
- The Era GSM digital mobile phone network has already contracted 40,000 subscribers.
- The Szczecin shipyard has handed over the newly built Nordsea container ship to the Cypriot contractor. The vessel can carry up to 1650 containers.
- The listed Elektrim engineering and foreign trade firm has acquired a 75 percent controlling stake the Zychlin-based EMIT SA electrical equipment and transformer maker worth 7.77 million zlotys.
